fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Florida public policy and local conditions, including criticism of loan-shark lending and calls to legalize and regulate gambling; discussion of pari-mutuel horse and dog racing and related political influence; notes on slot machines and marble-board gambling devices in Miami; and an editorial on proposed liquor taxation and the risk of prohibition returning. Also includes campus and society columns, nightlife and restaurant/club items, and sports/racing coverage and tipster warnings.
